Messages.Author: Jack Vinson
Messages.Body:
>>>>> "TL" == Thomas Lajeunesse <laje...@scinfo.u-nancy.fr> writes:

TL> 5th Tradition : Hospitality
TL> Can it be used by a vampire (Prince or Justicar) ON HIMSELF ?
TL> ie, he/she spends 1 blood, and regain all its blood capacity.
TL> ... unless it must be used only on another vampire (The
TL> Prince/Justicar welcomes another vampire by his/her home)

Sure, this works great with Minion Tap, although the 5th tradition can be
blocked if someone has intercept.

TL> Malkavian Dementia
TL> When does the dement malkavian untap, and when can he/she act ?

Minions untap at the beginning of the Untap phase. If you steal a tapped
Malkav, it can't do much. (Of course, you could always steal its
equipment. :-) Also, when the Malkav is transferred back to its previous
controller, it becomes untapped first (at the beginning of your untap) and
then moves back to the Meth.

Question: What happens if someone else Dements an already Demented Malkav?

TL> Bloodhunt after Diablerie (not the card)
TL> Who votes ? Which cards are usable ? Does the deuce always be a
TL> failure ?

The vote is called by any Methuselah to burn a vampire who just stole the
'soul' of another vampire. As this is a heinous crime, the Methuselahs act
directly, rather than a vampire calling the vote. Any vampire that has a
title may contribute its votes to the bloodhunt. Also, Methuselahs may
burn political cards or spend the Edge for votes. Action Modifiers and
Reaction cards may not be played as there is no minion action to modifier
or react to.

Messages.Author: Dale Hurtt
Messages.Body:
laje...@scinfo.u-nancy.fr (Thomas Lajeunesse) writes:

> 5th Tradition : Hospitality
> Can it be used by a vampire (Prince or Justicar) ON HIMSELF ?
> ie, he/she spends 1 blood, and regain all its blood capacity.
> ... unless it must be used only on another vampire (The
> Prince/Justicar welcomes another vampire by his/her home)

Yes, the Prince or Justicar can use it on themselves. I agree that it does not
"feel" right given what the card represents, however, the card places no
limitation such as you suggest on itself.

> Malkavian Dementia
> When does the dement malkavian untap, and when can he/she act ?

All cards untap during the UNTAP PHASE of the controller. If you take a tapped
Malkavian during your MASTER PHASE it will not untap until your following UNTAP
PHASE (at which time it will return to the original controller), unless you have
some type of untap card (such as Rat's Warning, etc.).

> Bloodhunt after Diablerie (not the card)
> Who votes ? Which cards are usable ? Does the deuce always be a
> failure ?

Anyone with a title can vote. A player with the Edge can throw in the Edge for 1
vote. No cards may be played during the bloodhunt vote. The condition of the
vote is to burn the diablerizer, so if the vote ties, it fails and the
diablerizer is not burned.

> Duncan IDAHO.

Messages.Author: Dale Hurtt
Messages.Body:
Jack Vinson <vin...@unagi.cis.upenn.edu> writes:

>Question: What happens if someone else Dements an already Demented Malkav?

Then they grab control from you. As you will no longer have the demented Malk.
during your UNTAP PHASE, you cannot return the vampire. When the second stealer
hits their UNTAP PHASE, the Malk. goes back to the original controller.

Why not back to the first stealer. The card states: "You control...until your
next untap phase." As the UNTAP PHASE has passed for the first stealer, control
would not return to him (or her).

> TL> Who votes ? Which cards are usable ? Does the deuce always be a

To the original poster: my reply stated that "no cards could be played" during
the bloodhunt vote. That was wrong. As Jack points out, vote cards can be used,
just not action modifiers or reaction cards. Sorry for the confusion.
